question: The absolute refractive index of_______is 2.42.
solution:
The correct answer is __**diamond**__.

__
 
• **The absolute refractive index of diamond is 2.42**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Absolute refractive index**

 
 
• The absolute refractive index is defined as the ratio of the speed of light in vacuum and in the given medium.
 
• The absolute refractive index should never be less than 1.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
